text:
maya: heads-up — sampleapp CI on main is failing after the latest typegen regen. looks like a semver guard caught a diff during publish and the e2e install step breaks. logs attached below. :grimacing:

maya: CI error snippet:
```
Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk'
Require stack:
 - /workspace/sampleapp/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/index.js
 - /workspace/sampleapp/src/bootstrap.js
npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
```

tj: ugh. which change in typegen? ordering, optional flags, or a new export? :eyes:

maya: regendiff shows only reorder of type definitions and a new overload for ClientOptions. no runtime API change but type signatures bumped in a way that triggered typegen's semver check. link: https://ci.redwood/incoming/regendiff/2155001234 (private)

eli: if it's just ordering + a harmless overload, semver should be patch. but our release tooling compares hashes and forced a minor because optional param got explicit undefined. probably a false positive.

oliver: can we short-circuit the semver guard for this patch? we shouldn't skirt the rules often.

sam: for onboarding unblock, we can pin the sampleapp to the last published @redwood/sdk:1.4.2 in package.json and merge. then follow up with a proper fix in typegen pipeline. quick patch command: `npm i @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 --save-exact`

maya: agree. PR opened to pin package and add a comment about the regen: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 (draft).

tj: alternative is to revert the typegen commit in the release branch and regen with stable config. which is less disruptive to the sampleapp but slower.

eli: also a race in the publish job: the changelog bump step used semantic-release heuristics that misread the regendiff commit message. we should tighten the release heuristics or add a special tag for auto-typegen-only changes.

oliver: filing an action item: 1) temporary pin in sampleapp (maya) 2) revert or rework typegen in feature branch (tj/eli) 3) add a release-gating rule for regendiff-only commits (oliver). created issue: https://github.com/redwood/internal/issues/2087

ci-bot: CI rerun queued by maya — build 2155001256

sam: once pinned, we should also add an onboarding note in docs/ that typegen regens may require pinning until publish stabilizes. small doc PR after merge.

maya: merging pin PR now to get new hires unblocked. follow-up todos in the issue. :shipit:

tj: for the long term, I think we should: add a regendiff-lint that detects innocuous reorder-only changes, update semantic-release config to ignore typegen-only commits for semver decisions, and add a canary publish flow for SDK packages so sampleapps can use next tags. filing follow-ups in the issue.

eli: +1. also add a unit in CI that installs from the published registry instead of local path for sampleapp e2e to catch publish-time breakage earlier.

maya: thanks all — will post a short retro once we have the fix chain.
